correctness.rationale: For closed range, the operator lower bound and scalar monotonicity make each increasing weakly convergent net norm Cauchy. Without closed range, the finite-codimensional near-kernel lemma yields normalized dual-annihilating vectors; a factor-four parameter net makes every increment positive, is weakly null against all dual functionals, and has norms tending to one. Order interval estimates yield normality exactly for operators bounded below. Complete quantifiers and boundary cases are checked analytically; the exact finite verifier is supplementary.

value.rationale: The source explicitly asks whether its non-normal Schur-space example has weak Dini convergence for nets. The result settles that natural unresolved case and gives a complete classification for a motivated operator-generated family using closed range, in direct contrast with automatic sequential convergence in \(\ell_1\). Its explicit bounded monotone weakly null construction distinguishes net and sequence behaviour and is a structural analytic resolution, not a routine finite sample or arbitrary unmotivated calculation.
